deadline.value: The priority deadline for admission and funding is December 15, 2026; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: December 15: Priority application deadline for admission and funding opportunities.

gre_general.value: The page marks the GRE optional for the 2024-2025 academic year; the rule for 2027 entry is not stated.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores - optional for the 2024-2025 academic year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to name faculty whose research interests them, but the page does not require an agreement before admission.
supervisor.quote: It would be helpful to mention 2-3 faculty members whose research appeals to you

funding.value: Tuition is fully covered and students receive a competitive stipend, through assistantships.
funding.quote: Tuition is fully covered, and students receive a competitive stipend for living expenses.

entry_route.value: An MS is not required before the PhD, and applicants can apply directly to the PhD program.
entry_route.quote: an MS is not required for pursuing a PhD
